content: GRAND GROUP CORPORATION is a dynamic, innovation-driven chemical enterprise headquartered in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province—China’s vibrant coastal hub for advanced manufacturing and international trade. Located at 13F, Pacific Plaza, No. 555 Jingjia Road, Ningbo, the company operates at the intersection of specialty chemical formulation, sustainable process engineering, and global supply chain excellence. With deep roots in fine chemical synthesis, polymer additives, and high-purity industrial intermediates, GRAND GROUP serves diverse sectors including automotive, electronics, construction, pharmaceuticals, and green energy. The company integrates R&D, production, quality assurance, and technical support under one cohesive framework, adhering rigorously to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and REACH-compliant standards. Its state-of-the-art laboratories and GMP-aligned production facilities enable rapid prototyping, customized solutions, and scalable manufacturing for both domestic and international clients across Asia, Europe, and North America. Committed to environmental stewardship, GRAND GROUP actively invests in cleaner production technologies, waste minimization systems, and lifecycle assessments to advance its ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) agenda. Beyond technical capability, the corporation prides itself on agile responsiveness, multilingual client engagement, and long-term partnership building. As Ningbo continues to evolve as a national pilot zone for chemical industry upgrading and digital transformation, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION stands as a trusted, forward-looking representative of China’s next-generation chemical industry—combining scientific rigor, operational integrity, and unwavering dedication to quality, sustainability, and collaborative growth.
